display-hero.purpose: The H1 only; Bodoni Moda at giant scale, tight and tracked in.

display-wall.purpose: The gallery heading, the largest h2.

display-phone.purpose: The booking number on the gold page; one line, lining tabular figures.

display-wordmark.purpose: The footer name in gold on cloth, beside the hibiscus mark.

headline.purpose: Every section h2; one phrase in the accent colour.

title-lg.purpose: The four steps of the story and the closing-card titles.

numeral.purpose: Counted facts in gold on cloth.

question.purpose: Accordion summaries and hours-table day names.

quote.purpose: Verbatim client reviews in Bodoni italic with explicit optical size 9 (7 for long quotes).

lead.purpose: The hero sentence in Jost, soft ink.

label.purpose: Functional micro-labels only: scroll hint, card price note, review attribution, loader subtitle.

hand.purpose: La Belle Aurore margin notes rotated -3 degrees; never headings or paragraphs.

shadows.name: plate
shadows.purpose: The enlarged photograph in the lightbox.

shadows.name: ribbon

shadows.name: cover-edge

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Expo out: default for CSS transitions (liquid fill .65s, link underline .6s, nav hide .7s).

motion.name: ease-io
motion.purpose: Expo in-out: the full-screen menu curtain (.9s).

motion.name: expo.out
motion.purpose: Reveals: headings, supporting copy (y 34px, 1.3s), cards, map, hero entrance.

motion.name: expo.inOut
motion.purpose: Cover opening (rotationY -106deg, 1.7s), wipes and curtains, accordion close.

motion.name: power3

motion.name: power2.inOut

motion.name: back.out

motion.name: sine.inOut
motion.purpose: Idle breathing of lead photographs and drifting petals.

narrative.overview:
The site is Séverine's agenda, opened for the visitor. A graphite book-cloth cover swings open on load; behind it are off-white ruled pages with a gold margin rule, gold-foil edges, and a gold ribbon marker hanging from the right edge that tracks how far you have read. Every section is a different page of the same book: cloth pages (savoir-faire, la semaine, avis, footer) alternate with paper pages (accueil, prestations, galerie, questions, nous trouver), with one gold leaf (the booking call) and one gold band (the marquee) as punctuation.

Personality is done by type and shape, not by decoration. Bodoni Moda at giant scale gives the editorial, jeweller's-box voice; Jost does all the reading; La Belle Aurore appears only as a handwritten agenda annotation. The almond silhouette of a nail frames the photographs, and the French-tip "smile" curve is the seam between pages. The palette is the three imposed brand colours and their derivatives; the client photographs are the only other chroma on the page. Density is low and unhurried: huge headlines, wide margins, long slow expo-eased motion.

The system is recognizable with all copy removed: gold fillet, almond frames, ribbon, ruled paper. It refuses the beauty-salon template (pastel hero, three icon cards, stock photo grid).
keyCharacteristics: Two surface themes, `.paper` (ruled agenda page) and `.cloth` (woven book-cloth), swapped section by section and joined by curved seams.
Champagne gold is flat foil: fills, hairlines, rings, bars, and large type on cloth. On paper, gold text is always gold-ink.
Almond-clipped photographs with a drawn gold hairline; a double gold fillet inset like a blind-stamped cover.
Bodoni Moda (optical sizing) for everything large; Jost for everything read; one handwritten voice for annotations.
Soft, long, negatively spread shadows only; depth otherwise comes from surface change and gold lines.
Pill buttons with a liquid fill; 14px cards; 4px paper notes.
Slow expo-eased motion, transform and opacity first, one distinct heading reveal per section, content readable without it.

rules.name: The Surface Flip Rule
rules.body: `.paper` and `.cloth` each define the same five semantic variables (`--fg`, `--fg-soft`, `--accent`, `--line`, `--focus`); components read those and never hardcode a theme colour. Paper: graphite / soft ink / gold-ink / rule / gold-ink. Cloth: paper / paper 76% / gold / gold at 28% / gold. On the gold booking page, text and focus are graphite and the emphasised phrase is graphite.

rules.name: The Two Golds Rule
rules.body: Gold #DCCA9B is for surfaces and for type on graphite. Gold text on paper is always #7A6633. There is no third gold.

rules.name: The Primary Inverts Rule
rules.body: The primary action is graphite on paper and on gold, and gold on cloth. Gold-on-paper would give a 1.5:1 button edge.

rules.name: The Photographs Are The Colour Rule
rules.body: The interface adds no hue beyond the three brand colours; the only chroma on a page comes from the client's nail photographs.

rules.name: The Optical Size Rule
rules.body: Bodoni Moda runs with `font-optical-sizing: auto` so display sizes get hairline contrast; small italic (quotes) sets `opsz` explicitly to 9 (7 for long quotes) so the hairlines stay readable. Weight stays 400 everywhere Bodoni appears.

rules.name: The One Phrase Rule
rules.body: In a section heading, one phrase sits in `<em>` at weight 400 in the accent colour (gold-ink on paper, gold on cloth, graphite on gold). The emphasis is a colour change, never a size or weight change. (Two headings also set the phrase in italic; see Not canonized.)

rules.name: The Hand Is A Margin Note Rule
rules.body: La Belle Aurore is only ever a short annotation rotated -3°, plus the hand-drawn ellipse around today's row. It is never a heading and never a paragraph.

rules.name: The Italic Is Voice Rule
rules.body: Bodoni italic carries quoted or annotated material: review quotes, photo captions, the marquee, numeral units, the "today" marker in the chart and hours table, the pressed mobile-menu link.

rules.name: The Page Edge Rule
rules.body: Content starts right of the gold margin rule and inside `--pad`; wide display type (the phone number, the footer wordmark) may bleed only through negative margins on its own line.

rules.name: The Curved Seam Rule
rules.body: Paper and cloth never meet along a straight horizontal line; every seam is a `--edge`-high ellipse (see Shapes).

rules.name: The Resting Sheet Rule
rules.body: Shadows are tall (14 to 40px offset), wide (30 to 80px blur), negatively spread (-10 to -34px), and graphite or black at .45 to .7 alpha; a short contact shadow (2 to 3px offset, .12 to .18 alpha) may sit under them. They describe a sheet resting above the page. Photographs, buttons and plain text blocks carry none.

dos: Do alternate cloth and paper sections and join every seam with the smile and arch ellipse (`--edge` high, 120% wide); punctuate with the gold band and the gold booking leaf.
Do read colour through `--fg`, `--fg-soft`, `--accent`, `--line` and `--focus` so any component works on both paper and cloth.
Do use gold-ink #7A6633 for every piece of gold text on paper, gold #DCCA9B for text on cloth, and graphite #464445 for text on gold.
Do make the primary action graphite on paper and gold, gold on cloth, a 999px pill at 52px minimum height (44px small) with the liquid fill on hover and focus.
Do frame lead photographs in the almond with a drawn gold hairline overlay and no shadow; reserve 6px rectangles for the gallery wall and the lightbox.

Do set display type in Bodoni Moda at weight 400 with optical sizing and tight leading (.88 to 1.0) and negative tracking; set reading text in Jost 400 at `clamp(1rem, .96rem + .22vw, 1.12rem)` / 1.62.
Do use La Belle Aurore for a short annotation rotated -3° (or the hand-drawn ellipse), nothing longer.
Do give each section heading its own reveal and trigger it once; supporting copy rises 34px and fades over 1.3s.
Do keep shadows tall, soft and negatively spread (Resting Sheet Rule), graphite-tinted.
Do keep a 2px focus ring in `--focus` at 4px offset, hit areas at 44px or more, and pointer effects (tilt, magnetic, mouse parallax) behind fine-hover checks.
Do keep hidden start states in script, ship the plain layout without it, and give every moving element a reduced-motion path.
donts: Don't set text in #DCCA9B on paper (1.5:1); that gold is for surfaces, hairlines and type on graphite.
Don't add a hue beyond the three brand colours and their listed derivatives; the nail photographs supply the colour.
Don't cut paper to cloth with a straight horizontal edge.
Don't fall back to the beauty-salon template: pastel hero, three icon cards, stock photo grid.
Don't frame lead photography in plain rectangles or circles outside the gallery wall.
Don't square a button or give it a radius other than the pill; cards are 14px, notes 4px, photos 6px.
Don't hardcode a paper or cloth colour inside a component that has to live on both.
Don't drive scroll choreography with width, height, top or left; transform, opacity, clip-path and stroke-dashoffset do that work.
Don't repeat a heading reveal style within the page, and don't hide content in CSS while waiting for script.
Don't show a hover-only affordance on touch; captions, controls and states must exist without hover.
